#  The best FDD on the market. Your foundation for AI-powered facilities.
The same information model and expert-system diagnostics that make Clockworks the most trusted FDD platform in the industry are what make real AI-powered automation possible — not a chatbot bolted onto basic data.
[See how it works](https://clockworksanalytics.com/software/) [Get a Demo →](https://go.clockworksanalytics.com/analytics-demo)
## THE INDUSTRY'S BEST BUILDING ANALYTICS SOFTWARE.
Clockworks’ Fault Detection and Diagnostics (FDD) platform plugs into existing building systems, analyzes thousands of data points, and pinpoints the highest impact performance issues, complete with diagnostics.
####  OPTIMIZE ENERGY PERFORMANCE 
Reduce consumption, cut carbon, meet sustainability targets. 
####  IMPROVE INDOOR ENVIRONMENT 
Deliver consistent comfort and healthy air across every space. 
####  ENHANCE EQUIPMENT RELIABILITY 
Catch faults before they become critical failures. 
#### "This is the essential foundation for AI-Powered Facilities that AI-wrapper software can't provide. Clockworks combines meaningful knowledge with automated action to deliver valuable outcomes"
OUR FOUNDATION
## ONE GLOBAL MODEL, 50+ EXPERT SYSTEMS
We’ve taken the **largest, connected asset portfolio in the world** and normalized it against a physics-based global information model. The result in the most accurate root-cause diagnostics on the market today.
01 — The Global Model
### A consistent way to describe every asset, everywhere
99% of the built environment contains completely unstructured data, with no standard applied. The same sensor can be described twenty ways. Clockworks normalizes it all into one machine-readable model, and it gets smarter with every building onboarded.
**600,000+** pieces of equipment modeled
**5.8M+** data points classified daily
02 — Expert Systems AI
### Physics-based models, running continuously
Expert systems encode real engineering knowledge—thermodynamics, heat transfer, control logic—instead of statistically guessing. Clockworks has 50+ expert systems that have been growing more intelligent over the past fifteen years with every new building or piece of equipment onboarded.
**50+** expert systems, purpose-built per system type
**27,000+** air handlers · **5,000+** chillers · **380,000+** zone equipment

AI Summary Generated
Bldg2_AHU-3 has multiple related control and airside faults that are likely interacting: the unit shows a stuck/static minimum outdoor air damper condition, economizer logic problems (running when it should be off, low lockout, missing high-limit enthalpy sequence), inconsistent static pressure control, and major heating/cooling overlap including a very large likely preheat valve leak or control issue plus possible cooling valve leakage.
These issues are driving the biggest energy waste, with comfort impacts from poor static pressure control, elevated return air humidity, and low outside air at times. The best corrective path is to first fix the core control/valve sequencing problems, then verify fan/static pressure control, and only then confirm sensor calibration and any remaining mechanical damper faults.

Problem: Simultaneous Heating and Cooling

Possible Causes:
